subject: FinPay MAP & stakeholder map — next steps

Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 15:00:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP next steps

Hi Tom — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned:  \n
- Summary: demo covered latency/cost profile, routing fallbacks, and Dedicated option for predictable throughput.
- Key decision criteria you mentioned: 1) SOC2 + data residency guarantees, 2) procurement timeline and PO process, 3) ability to pin a model version for pilot.
- Stakeholders you said would be involved: Linda Park (CFO, economic buyer), Procurement team (contract/PO), Security (SOC2 review), and Eng lead for integration.

Proposed MAP (high level):
1) Security review & SOC2 evidence — FinPay security to receive SOC2 and architecture overview (this week)
2) Pilot define success metrics & scope — joint session to finalize (by 12/10)
3) Contract & PO — procurement review and PO issuance (target before 1/15)

Can you confirm the owners and any missing stakeholders? I’ll draft a MAP spreadsheet and share a link once I have the confirmed list.  \n
Also, what’s the preferred intake for SOC2 evidence — direct email or a shared secure link?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. Confirming stakeholders and timeline from our side:  \n
- Economic buyer: Linda Park (CFO) — Linda will sign off on commercial terms.
- Security reviewer: Ajay Mehta (info-security@finpay.com) — will need SOC2 Type II and an architecture diagram.
- Procurement: procurement@finpay.com — typical PO process (legal review + PO creation).
- Eng/Integration lead: Sara Lopez (sara.lopez@finpay.com) — will own the pilot integration.

Timeline:
- Security review kickoff: week of 12/6
- Pilot scope finalized: target 12/10
- Legal/procurement review: Dec -> early Jan
- PO target: by 2027-01-15 (hard deadline for Q1 budget)

Preferred way to receive SOC2 is secure link (Dropbox/Drive with restricted access) or direct SFTP. I’ll loop Ajay if you want to coordinate technical docs.

Also please include an initial SOW outline and estimated cost range for the pilot in the MAP — Linda wants a ballpark before the legal review.

Tom

Head of Platform Partnerships | FinPay
Tom.harris@finpay.com | (617) 555-9988
